messages.author: 5560d572c53b8547
messages.subject: Graph plotting non-existing values
parts:
Hello, I have a question about the plotting of values that don't seem to exist in my dataset. I have produced the following plot:




Here is the code that I used: qplot(data=parties_populism,x=parties_populism$Year,y=parties_populism$Populist.Score, color=Party, facets = ~Party, na.rm = TRUE, xlab = "Year", ylab = "Populism Score", main = "Figure X.X: Populism Scores Per Party over Time", + ylim(c(0,0.25))) + stat_smooth(method='lm') + xlim(1945, 2013) + ylim(0, 0.25) 
 
My problem is that it seems like ggplot is plotting non-existent values. When you look at the plot for "D66" is plots values from the start of the timeline until the end - however, when looking in the dataset (see attached file), these values simply don't exist. The first value for D66 is in 1968, so I was hoping that you could explain what is going on here? 

Thank you in advance.

Best regards,

Daniel Hansen

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Graph plotting non-existing values
parts:
You should never use $ in a ggplot2 call.
Hadley
